name: notifier
summary: Sends a message to Telegram, Discord, Slack or a signed webhook when an app starts, stops, restarts, crashes, loops, goes over its memory limit or fails a health check. Adds the notify command.
head: Asks for permission to
perms: Read app status and lifecycle events (read access only)
Make outbound network connections; the manifest names api.telegram.org, discord.com and hooks.slack.com
Write only to its own state directory
Receive OXIDEPM_TELEGRAM_TOKEN from the daemon's environment
cmd: Built and tested, not published yet: there is no archive to download and no signed index. Once there is one, import it from an archive pinned by its SHA-256.

name: exporter-prometheus
summary: Serves /metrics in the Prometheus text format on 127.0.0.1:9616. On each scrape it asks the daemon for the status of the apps, and answers 503 with oxidepm_up 0 when it cannot.
head: Asks for permission to
perms: Read app status (read access only)
Make outbound network connections (no hosts named)
Read its own state directory, write nothing
cmd: Built and tested, not published yet: there is no archive to download and no signed index. Once there is one, import it from an archive pinned by its SHA-256.

name: ui-web
summary: Serves a REST API and a WebSocket on 127.0.0.1:9615. Every request needs an access key. By default it can show apps and restart, stop and reload the ones that list it, and it cannot create or delete apps or flush logs. Adds the web command.
head: Asks for permission to
perms: Control the apps that list it (lifecycle access, opted-in apps only)
Receive lifecycle events
Read and write only its own state directory
cmd: Built and tested, not published yet: there is no archive to download and no signed index. Once there is one, import it from an archive pinned by its SHA-256.

name: ui-tui
summary: The terminal dashboard: the apps with state, CPU and memory, the selected app in detail and its log. Stopping or restarting an app asks for y or n first. Runs only while the dashboard is open. Adds the monit command.
head: Asks for permission to
perms: Stop and restart apps (lifecycle access, all apps)
No network connections
No file access of its own
cmd: Built and tested, not published yet: there is no archive to download and no signed index. Once there is one, import it from an archive pinned by its SHA-256.

name: runtime-node
summary: Runs Node.js apps: the node, npm, pnpm and yarn runtimes. It tells the daemon what to run and the daemon runs it.
head: Asks for permission to
perms: Read app status (read access only)
No network connections
Read only its own state directory, write nothing
Start no programs of its own: it tells the daemon what to run
cmd: Carried, signed, by each release under share/oxidepm/adapters. Import it with: oxidepm adapter import --bundled --tag runtime --enable --yes (the install script does this for you).

name: runtime-python
summary: Runs Python apps, in the project's virtualenv when it has one. Provides the python runtime.

cmd: Carried, signed, by each release under share/oxidepm/adapters. Import it with: oxidepm adapter import --bundled --tag runtime --enable --yes (the install script does this for you).

cmd: Carried, signed, by each release under share/oxidepm/adapters. Import it with: oxidepm adapter import --bundled --tag runtime --enable --yes (the install script does this for you).
